description:
The same as the `amip` DECK experiment, except that SSTs are subject to a uniform cooling of 4K. This warming should be applied to the ice-free ocean surface only. Sea ice and SSTs in grid boxes containing sea ice remain the same as in the `amip` DECK experiment. 

Reference: [Ceppi et al., 2026](https://doi.org/10.5194/gmd-19-8693-2026)
